title: BW26 Trans & BLS
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.AMC.ACC.ACC-OO.413TH CSB.0413 AQ HQ     CONTRACT AUG
description_text: This is support required to enable Bersama Warrior 2026 (BW). Requirments are for transportation (Buses, baggage trucks and Vans), one generator, one unterupted power supply (UPS) and one printer with paper and toner. Exercise date will be from 28 May - 15 June.
